record.body:
## Rationale

The user chose this. The estimate scales the threshold to the task, so long tasks do not flag early; keeping it out of Needs you avoids false alarms becoming gates.

## Counter-argument

A fixed threshold is predictable and does not depend on estimates being accurate or present.

payload.alternatives: a fixed 30 minute threshold; no flag; also a Check on task Needs you item
payload.choice: A running task is quiet when its latest record is older than twice its estimate_minutes, or 60 minutes without an estimate; it is flagged on the row and wave strip only, not in Needs you

record.subject: quiet-threshold
